description: This PHP source file defines the class SugarFeedFlush, which contains a method to flush stale entries from the SugarFeed. The method checks for a specific flush date setting and deletes entries older than 14 days from the database.

classes.name: SugarFeedFlush
classes.description: A class responsible for flushing stale entries from the SugarFeed, specifically deleting records older than 14 days based on a configured flush date.

methods.name: flushStaleEntries
methods.description: Checks the last flush date and deletes feed entries older than 14 days if the date has changed.
